source_text: 32 GENTILIBUS. Gens sine pastore ferox iam noli uagare. Et ego, qui moneo, idem fui nescius errans. Nunc ideo Domini figuram sumite uestri, Tollite corda fera et exasperate seorsum: Intrate stabulis, siluestris, ad praesepia tauri, Latronibus tuti sub regis tecta manentes. In silua lupi sunt, ideo refugite sub antro. Bellaris, insanis nec respicis, ubi moraris. Uno crede Deo, ubi mortuus uiuere possis Surgas et in regno, cum sit resurrectio iustis.
pass_a_gloss: Gens sine pastore — noli uagare. Domini figuram sumite. Uno crede Deo → mortuus uiuere; surgas in regno.
pass_b_english: O wild people without a shepherd, wander no longer. I too who warn you was the same, unknowing, astray. Now therefore take your Lord’s figure; lift wild hearts and put roughness aside. Enter the stalls, woodland ones, to the oxen’s mangers, safe from robbers, remaining under the king’s roof. In the wood are wolves — flee under the cave. You make war, you rave, nor look where you linger. Believe in one God, where when dead you can live, and rise in the kingdom, since there is resurrection for the just.
